name: e2e-smoke
notes: First Slurm test of the whole path (scripts/e2e-batch.sh): one corpus-wide question (q01) and one ambiguous one (q10), both conditions, one repeat = 4 runs. No budget here: the runs take the `agent run` and `agent attach` defaults, so they test what m4-72 will use. Concept paths are the frozen concept.json of each concept session ($CONCEPTS = concepts).
